question: Tell me about a time you used data to change a product decision.
answer: At Acme Cloud our self-serve activation was stuck around 31%. I pulled funnel data in Amplitude and saw 40% of users dropped at step three of the setup wizard, where we asked for a data source connection before showing any value. I proposed moving the connection step after a sample-data preview, got buy-in from our designer and engineering lead by showing the drop-off chart, and we ran an A/B test for three weeks. The variant lifted activation from 31% to 44%, which the growth team estimated was worth roughly an extra 600 activated accounts a quarter. I then rolled it out and documented the test so we reused the pattern on two other flows.

question: Describe a time you had to align engineering and design on a disagreement.
answer: On the setup wizard redesign, design wanted a five step guided flow and engineering wanted to keep it to a single page because of the complexity. I set up a working session where each side explained the constraint behind their preference. It turned out design cared about reducing cognitive load and engineering cared about not rewriting the validation layer. I proposed a middle path, a three step flow reusing the existing validation, and we agreed to test it. It shipped on time and both teams felt heard, and we kept that working-session format for later projects.
